findings.claim: kmctl's README Upgrade section said auditing moved to kmaudit, but kmctl's own audit still ships.

verdict.text: Round 3 changes only the test name and docstring flagged in round 2's notes.
The new docstring is accurate: it no longer calls kmaudit the new home of auditing.
I ran `git diff refs/loop/upgrade-from-v0-12-docs/r2` in the worktree.
It touches one file, packages/kmctl/tests/test_docs.py, with two lines changed.

`test_upgrade_docs_send_auditing_to_kmaudit` is now `test_upgrade_docs_link_kmaudit`, and its docstring says kmctl's README links kmaudit's README, the separate package that checks docs against the code.
That matches what the test asserts (the `](../kmaudit/README.md)` link) and agrees with the round 2 fix to the README.
Row r1's command, `uv run pytest packages/kmctl/tests/test_docs.py -k upgrade -q`, still selects the renamed test: 3 passed, 9 deselected.
This round binds fingerprint 7fd72251532329f48a5636398c77e3898b46d584b71fc2f830bfc83550448058, the green stamp the briefing names, so I did not re-run the stamp.
f1 stays resolved, as it was in round 2.
The README no longer says auditing moved to kmaudit, and the test docstring now agrees with it.
